description: This file manages agent configurations, including listing, resolving, building summaries, applying, and pruning agent settings within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: findAgentEntryIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of an agent entry in the list based on agent ID.

methods.name: resolveAgentName
methods.description: Resolves the name of an agent given the configuration and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveAgentModel
methods.description: Resolves the model associated with an agent based on configuration and agent ID.

methods.name: parseIdentityMarkdown
methods.description: Parses markdown content into an AgentIdentity object.

methods.name: loadAgentIdentity
methods.description: Loads agent identity from a workspace, returning null if not available or invalid.

methods.name: buildAgentSummaries
methods.description: Builds summaries for all agents configured, including identity and binding info.

methods.name: applyAgentConfig
methods.description: Applies new configuration settings to an agent, updating or adding it.

methods.name: pruneAgentConfig
methods.description: Removes an agent and related bindings and permissions from the configuration.
